rows.item: Exploring the Alpha Mind / Single session (45 min) (R775, no course)
rows.steps: open /shop/exploring-the-alpha-mind-45-minutes; pick Single session (45 min); Add to Cart; /cart; apply voucher QA-SELFTEST-100; /checkout; fill contact; Continue to Payment; Place order
rows.expected: R775 on product and cart; voucher gives R0 total; order places with no payment gateway; confirmation shows order number and persona email; no console errors or failed requests
rows.actual: Product page R775,00 (single session variant preselected, clicked anyway). Cart line R775,00, subtotal R775,00. After voucher: Voucher (QA-SELFTEST-100) -R775,00, Total R0,00. Checkout shows R0,00; payment step says 'Your voucher covers the full amount. There is nothing to pay.' then 'Place order'. Confirmation at /checkout/confirmation?free=1&order=242&cartId=cart_01M4Z79PGTFT3T78FXGM5Z74AQ: 'Thank You! Order #242 is confirmed. We're excited to support your transformation journey.' 'A receipt has been sent to your email address.' Persona email NOT shown on confirmation page (it is shown on the checkout payment step). No gateway. No 4xx in the flow. Cart page still says 'PayFast (South Africa) or PayPal (international)' under a R0 order (minor). Checkout has no address fields (only name, email, phone, billing country), so address from the persona was not entered. Mail receipt not verified.
console_errors: 3x 404 resource errors for /this-page-does-not-exist and /shop/no-such-product-xyz, not caused by this run (earlier session in the shared browser)
